name: Bright Services LLC
old_description: We’re proud to be the go-to local electrician for new construction projects in Bend and surrounding Central Oregon communities.
about:
Bright Services LLC is an electrical contractor headquartered in Bend, Oregon, serving the surrounding Central Oregon region. The company was founded by electricians with 18 years of industry experience who set out to become Bend's go-to electrical contractor. No founding year is publicly disclosed, and ownership details such as family or veteran status are not specified.

The firm provides a full range of electrical installation and repair services for both commercial and residential construction. Its capabilities include commercial electrical construction, residential wiring for custom and tract homes, multi-family housing projects, electrical panel upgrades, generator installation, low-voltage systems, and general inspections and repairs. The company operates with a team of licensed and bonded electricians, though facility size and headcount are not published.

Bright Services works with residential homeowners, commercial builders, and developers across Central Oregon. Notable project types include medical buildings, apartment complexes, custom single-family homes, and tract housing developments. The company emphasizes tailored estimates rather than fixed pricing, and offers a one-year warranty on materials and labor.

The business was started with a mission to deliver reliable, communicative service in a trade often criticized for inconsistency. Its founders cite three pillars—reliability, respect, and resilience—as the foundation of their approach, promising timely work, careful treatment of client property, and persistent problem-solving on complex jobs.
